about: KEDAR INDUSTRIES is a trusted manufacturer of Electrical Control Panels, specializing in Capacitor Part Fabrication and Precision Soldering & Brazing activities. The firm delivers engineering solutions for a range of industrial sectors through innovation, precision, and customer-focused service. The manufacturing facility is equipped with advanced machinery, skilled technicians, and modern quality-control systems, enabling production of reliable and durable products in compliance with national and international standards. As a quality-focused organization, Kedar Industries continuously invests in technology, process improvement, and workforce development for superior performance, safety, and environmental responsibility.
